product_one_liner.value: Kojo helps construction trade contractors manage materials procurement, inventory, tools, prefab workflows and invoice processing in one connected platform.

pricing_page.notes: Public pricing page describes product packages and included features; numerical prices are not published.

eng_blog.notes: The company blog contains marketing, industry insights, product announcements and employee stories; no qualifying engineering-blog series was established.

public_docs.notes: Public help center includes product guides, troubleshooting and release notes.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The readable board lists Demand Gen Lead and Revenue Operations Support Analyst, neither a qualifying AI/ML/data-science title.

model_provider.value: OpenAI GPT-4 and Hugging Face transformer models

last_funding.notes: Reported September 12, 2025 as a $10 million extension from Wesco; Kojo subsequently issued an October 16, 2025 announcement of the extension.

raised_18mo.notes: The September 2025 extension falls within 2025-05-09 through 2026-11-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Neither of the two listed openings is an SDR, BDR or account executive role.

launched_6mo.notes: August 2026 releases introduced configurable invoice-matching tolerances and role-based tool inventory permissions; these are functional capabilities, not the accompanying UI refreshes.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Micah Rodman announced becoming CEO on February 2, 2026, with Maria Davidson moving to Executive Chairman; this is an internal leadership succession, not an external hire or company departure.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Salesforce and DocuSign are explicitly described as operational systems. The other systems are named in marketing-stack or GTM-tool requirements, indicating stack signals rather than independently verified deployments.
